_sources.discrepancies: 2026-06-10 verification: NYSBOE confirms the June 23, 2026 primary (registration deadline June 13; early voting June 13-21) and the November 3, 2026 general. The general-election registration deadline previously carried forward as 2026-10-09 (old 25-day rule) was corrected to 2026-10-24 per NYSBOE registration-and-voting-deadlines (10-day rule). Party enrollment rule verified: changes after February 14, 2026 take effect June 30, 2026, one week after the primary (NY Election Law 5-304(3)); the prior '25 days before the general' description was outdated and replaced.

earlyVoting.notes: Early voting hours vary by county. New York provides at least 9 days of early voting, the 10th day through the 2nd day before Election Day.

votingRules.phonesAtPollsDetail: New York voters may use phones to refer to voting information. Taking photos inside the voting booth is not permitted.
additionalRules: Closed primary: only voters enrolled in a party may vote in that party's primary. Unaffiliated voters may not vote in partisan primaries.

To vote in a 2026 partisan primary you must have been enrolled in that party by February 14, 2026 — party enrollment changes made after that date take effect June 30, 2026, one week after the primary (NY Election Law 5-304).

voteByMail.returnDeadline: Received by the board of elections no later than the close of polls on Election Day, or postmarked by Election Day and received within 7 days after
voteByMail.returnDeadlinePlain: Must arrive by poll closing on Election Day, or be postmarked by Election Day and received within 7 days after.

primaryParticipation.ruleExplanationEn: New York has a closed primary (NY Election Law §6-100). Only voters enrolled in a political party may vote in that party's primary. Voters who are not enrolled with a party (independent, blank, or unaffiliated) may not vote in a partisan primary.
primaryParticipation.ruleExplanationEs: Nueva York tiene una primaria cerrada (NY Election Law §6-100). Solo los votantes inscritos en un partido político pueden votar en la primaria de ese partido. Los votantes no inscritos en ningún partido (independientes, en blanco o sin afiliación) no pueden votar en una primaria partidista.
